selection.edition: international Listen Notes Podcast API v2
selection.ownership: Listen Notes, Inc., a Delaware C-Corp (October 2017) with HQ at 600 California Street, San Francisco; global Podcast API at listen-api.listennotes.com.

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official Listen Notes Podcast API v2 (X-ListenAPI-Key, host https://listen-api.listennotes.com/api/v2, GET /languages, GET /genres, GET /regions, GET /podcasts/{id}), company identity (Listen Notes, Inc., San Francisco), billing/quota docs, 2018 outage postmortem, and dated incident search (Listen Notes + security breach/incident). The 2018 Redis/Postgres outage is availability, not a customer-data compromise. No qualifying current unresolved Listen Notes API security incident was identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international Listen Notes Podcast API v2
research.searchCoverage: Official Listen Notes Podcast API documents HTTPS host https://listen-api.listennotes.com/api/v2, X-ListenAPI-Key, GET /languages, GET /genres, GET /regions, and GET /podcasts/{id}. Operator is Listen Notes, Inc. (Delaware C-Corp, San Francisco). GET /search is quota-sensitive and is omitted as healthcheck. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found the 2018-04-22 availability outage, not a customer-data compromise.

incidents.finding: Listen Notes published a postmortem for an approximately four-hour website outage caused by Redis page-cache memory growth colocated with Postgres. Recorded as a historical non-China availability incident, not a qualifying unresolved API security incident.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified. Full-text search is omitted because it is the documented billable search endpoint.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /languages, matching the pinned credential validator. Full-text GET /search is omitted as healthcheck because official docs describe it as the quota-limited search endpoint.
Native category is utility: Listen Notes is a podcast directory API. Source Data is not in the Rust CATEGORIES allowlist.
The upstream user-agent is not sent.
Maps to documented GET /languages. Returns raw Listen Notes JSON under data.
Maps to documented GET /genres. Optional topLevelOnly is the official 0/1 top_level_only query and is omitted when unset so origin callers that send {} still hit GET /genres.
Maps to documented GET /regions. Returns raw Listen Notes JSON under data.
id is a required path segment on documented GET /podcasts/{id}. Optional sort and next_episode_pub_date use official query names.
Maps to documented GET /search. Optional Composio filters use official query names and are omitted when unset. Returns raw Listen Notes JSON under data.
Maps to documented GET /typeahead. Optional show_podcasts, show_genres, and safe_mode 0/1 flags are omitted when unset.
Maps to documented GET /best_podcasts. genreId maps to genre_id; optional language, safe_mode, and publisher_region match the official query names.
Maps to documented GET /episodes/{id}. Optional showTranscript is the official 0/1 show_transcript query.
Maps to documented POST /podcasts as application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Optional rsses, itunes_ids, spotify_ids, show_latest_episodes, and next_episode_pub_date are omitted when unset.
Maps to documented POST /episodes as application/x-www-form-urlencoded with required ids.
Maps to documented GET /just_listen. Returns a random episode object under data.
Maps to documented GET /podcasts/{id}/recommendations. Optional safeMode is official 0/1 safe_mode.
Maps to documented GET /episodes/{id}/recommendations. Optional safeMode is official 0/1 safe_mode.
Maps to documented GET /curated_podcasts with optional page.
Maps to documented GET /curated_podcasts/{id}.
Maps to documented GET /playlists with optional page and sort.
Maps to documented GET /playlists/{id}. Optional sort, type, and last_timestamp_ms match the official query names.
Maps to documented GET /trending_searches.
Maps to documented GET /search_episode_titles. podcastId maps to podcast_id and podcastIdType to podcast_id_type.
Maps to documented GET /podcasts/{id}/audience (Insights API).
Maps to documented GET /podcasts/domains/{domain_name}. domainName is the path segment; optional page is omitted when unset.
Maps to documented GET /related_searches?q= (PRO/ENTERPRISE).
Maps to documented POST /podcasts/{id}/rss. No request body.
Maps to documented DELETE /podcasts/{id}. Optional reason query; official docs treat reason=testing as a dry run.
Maps to documented GET /spellcheck?q= (PRO/ENTERPRISE).
Maps to documented POST /podcasts/submit as application/x-www-form-urlencoded with required rss and optional email.
